description: This file defines a Vue.js Pinia store for managing meal plans, including functions for fetching, creating, updating, and deleting meal plans via an API, as well as state management and computed properties.

methods.name: refreshLastUpdatedPeriod
methods.description: Refreshes the meal plan list based on the last API refresh period.

methods.name: refreshFromAPI
methods.description: Fetches meal plans from the API within a date range and updates the store.

methods.name: recLoadMealPlans
methods.description: Recursively loads paginated meal plan data from the API.

methods.name: createOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates a new meal plan or updates an existing one.

methods.name: createObject
methods.description: Creates a new meal plan via API and updates the store.

methods.name: updateObject
methods.description: Updates an existing meal plan via API.

methods.name: deleteObject
methods.description: Deletes a meal plan via API and updates the store.
